features.name: v1_centered_z
features.description: Z-standardized V1 coordinate using fixed training-fold mean and spread.
features.expected_model_benefit: Stabilizes the V1 contribution by putting it on a comparable numeric scale for SVM margins.

features.name: v2_centered_z
features.description: Z-standardized V2 coordinate using fixed training-fold mean and spread.
features.expected_model_benefit: Puts V2 on comparable scale with other inputs and supports stable spatial margins.

features.name: v3_centered_z
features.description: Z-standardized V3 magnitude using fixed training-fold mean and spread.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights smooth departures from typical V3 levels with a continuous margin-friendly signal.

features.name: coordinate_balance_ratio
features.description: Signed ratio comparing V1 with V2; near zero when the two coordinates are balanced.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a scale-stable diagonal projection for margins sensitive to asymmetric spatial layout.

features.name: central_radial_distance
features.description: Euclidean distance from the central point (512, 512) after scaling both axes by the training-fold half-range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Turns radial geometry into a single smooth coordinate that a linear SVM can weight directly.

features.name: edge_proximity_severity
features.description: Severity of closeness to any observed coordinate boundary; 0 near the center and 1 on a border.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows a linear SVM to model edge effects without many hard threshold indicators.

features.name: axis_anisotropy
features.description: Difference between squared horizontal and vertical displacements from the center point.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a quadratic contrast as a linear input, useful for elongated spatial structure.

features.name: centered_xy_interaction
features.description: Product of centered horizontal and vertical displacements scaled by squared half-range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes quadrant-style interaction as one signed continuous feature for margin shaping.

features.name: v3_log_intensity
features.description: Log-scaled V3 magnitude using a fixed multiplier to compress high values while preserving order.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures diminishing sensitivity to larger V3 values and can improve linear margin calibration.

features.name: radial_adjusted_v3_ratio
features.description: V3 normalized by its observed high value and divided by one plus central radial distance.
features.expected_model_benefit: Emphasizes elevated V3 near central coordinates while remaining smooth and bounded.

features.name: terrain_prominence_judgment
features.description: Assessor score from 0 to 1 for how prominent V3 appears relative to the row's spatial context and training-fold V3 range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a domain-style continuous cue for unusual terrain intensity that algebraic terms may only approximate.

features.name: spatial_pattern_coherence_judgment
features.description: Assessor score from 0 to 1 for whether V1, V2, and V3 jointly resemble a coherent volcanic terrain pattern, considering centrality, boundary proximity, diagonal position, and intensity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a bounded semantic composite that a linear SVM can weight as an additional smooth projection.
